    Winfrey won an oratory contest, which secured her a full scholarship to Tennessee State University, a historically black institution, where she studied communication. However, she did not deliver her final paper until 1987, by which time she was a successful television personality.

    Description

    Tennessee State University is a public historically black land-grant university in Nashville, Tennessee, United States. Founded in 1912, it is the only state-funded historically black university in Tennessee. It is a member-school of the Thurgood Marshall College Fund. Wikipedia
    Address: 3500 John A Merritt Blvd, Nashville, TN 37209
    President: Dwayne Tucker
    Mascot: Aristocat the Tiger
    Undergraduate tuition and fees: In-state tuition 8,568 USD, Out-of-state tuition 22,284 USD (2023 – 24) IPEDS
    Campus: Large city, 903 acres (365 ha)
    Students: 8,198 (fall 2023)
    Acceptance rate: 70.1% (2024) IPEDS
    Colors: Blue and white;
    Graduation rate: 31.2% (For first-time, full-time in 2023–24)
    Nickname: Tigers and Lady Tigers
    Established: June 19, 1912; 113 years ago
    Average act: 18 prepscholar.com
    Endowment: $91.1 million (2021)
    Phone: (615) 963-5000
